name: ust-light
description: UST 1.0 LIGHT floor — standalone, zero-dependency sign/verify for canonical, addressable, string-only signed state. A ust-light document is a valid UST document.

ust:browser.why: The LIGHT floor is asynchronous everywhere on WebCrypto rather than carrying a second build, so the single file IS the browser file. A floor that refused the browser would not be a floor.
